title: The Rat Race: How Modern Capitalism is Crushing Lives 🏃💨 (2x Harder for Disabled People ♿)
excerpt: You borrow to study 📚💸. You can't find a job 😰. You borrow to eat 🍽️. You borrow to pay rent 🏠. You borrow from Bob to pay Paul, from John to pay Bob 🔄💰. The cycle never ends—until you die ⚰️. This is the rat race 🐀, and for disabled people like Mary & Lydia, it's twice as brutal. No loans for wheelchairs ♿❌. No employment for the disabled 🚫. No escape from the grind that crushes even able-bodied professionals.
author: AbleHearts Team
content:

[The Employment Crisis: Degrees Without Jobs](#the-employment-crisis-degrees-without-jobs) 4. [The Borrowing Cycle: Rob Peter to Pay Paul](#the-borrowing-cycle-rob-peter-to-pay-paul) 5. [Inflation: The Silent Killer](#inflation-the-silent-killer) 6. [Taxation: Death by a Thousand Cuts](#taxation-death-by-a-thousand-cuts) 7. [Even Professionals Are Suffering](#even-professionals-are-suffering) 8. [The Capitalist Scavenger System](#the-capitalist-scavenger-system) 9. [For Disabled People: The Rat Race on Hard Mode](#for-disabled-people-the-rat-race-on-hard-mode) 10. [Why Mary & Lydia Can't Even Enter the Race](#why-mary--lydia-cant-even-enter-the-race) 11. [Breaking the Cycle: What Needs to Change](#breaking-the-cycle-what-needs-to-change) --- ## What is the Rat Race? 🐀🏃💨 **The rat race is a vicious cycle where you work to survive, borrow to live, and die in debt.** ⚰️💸 It looks like this: 📋 1. **You're told**: "Study hard, get good grades, you'll succeed" 🎓✨ 2. **Reality**: You graduate with loans, no job, and crushing debt 💔📜 3. **You borrow** to eat, pay rent, dress presentably for interviews 🍽️🏠👔 4. **You borrow again** to pay the first loan 🔄💰 5. **Repeat** until you die ♾️⚰️ **It's called a "rat race" because:** 🐀 - You're running as fast as you can 🏃‍♂️💨 - You're going nowhere 🔄 - You're trapped in a cage (debt, bills, survival) 🗝️❌ - The only finish line is death 💀 And for **disabled people**, this race is **twice as hard** because: ♿💔 - They start with a handicap (literally) 🚧 - The track is not accessible 🚫 - No one gives them loans for wheelchairs or assistive devices 💸❌ - Employment doors are locked before they even knock 🚪🔒 --- ## The Education Trap: HELB Loans & False Promises 🎓💸 ### The Promise 🎯 > Education is the key to success 🔑. Get a degree, and your life will change. 📜✨ **The Reality in Kenya:** 🇰🇪 - **HELB (Higher Education Loans Board)** gives students loans to study 💰📚 - Students graduate with **Ksh 200,000 - 500,000+ in debt** 💸 - **No jobs** waiting for them 😰🚫 - **Loan repayment starts immediately** (whether you have income or not) ⏰💔 - **Interest accumulates** every month you can't pay 📈😱 ### The Cruel Math 🔢💔 **Example:** - HELB Loan: **Ksh 400,000** 💰 - Interest Rate: **4% per year** (compounding) 📊 - Repayment Period: **4 years after graduation** ⏳ - Monthly Payment Required: **~Ksh 9,000** 💸 **But:** 😰 - **60% of graduates** can't find employment in their field 🚫💼 - **Entry-level salary** (if you're lucky): Ksh 25,000/month 💵 - **After HELB payment**: Ksh 16,000 left 💸 - **Rent** (Nairobi): Ksh 10,000 minimum 🏠 - **Transport**: Ksh 3,000 🚌 - **Food**: Ksh 5,000 minimum 🍽️ - **What's left?** **-Ksh 2,000** (you're already in the negative!) ❌💔 **You're broke BEFORE you even live.** 😭💸 ### Community Fundraisings (Harambees) 🤝💰 Many families hold **harambees** (community fundraisings) to send students to university: - Relatives contribute Ksh 5,000, 10,000, 50,000 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💵 - Parents sell livestock, land, or take high-interest loans 🐄🏡💸 - The student graduates... 🎓 - **And can't find a job** 😰🚫 - **And can't pay back the community** 💔 - **Shame, guilt, and family pressure** multiply 😞😣 **The education trap doesn't end at graduation—it follows you for life.** ♾️🪤 --- ## The Employment Crisis: Degrees Without Jobs 🎓❌💼 ### The Brutal Statistics 📊😱 In Kenya: 🇰🇪 - **1,000,000+ graduates** per year (universities + colleges) 🎓 - **~200,000 formal jobs** created per year 💼 - **800,000 graduates** with no employment 😰❌ - **Youth unemployment**: ~40% 📈💔 **What this means:** 😔 - 4 out of 5 graduates have NO job in their field 🚫 - Degrees in Engineering, Business, IT, Medicine—**useless without employment** 📜❌ - You spent 4 years studying, borrowed hundreds of thousands, and now you're **unemployed** 😭💸 ### The Underemployment Trap 🔗💼 Even those "lucky enough" to find work face: - **Underpayment**: Ksh 15,000 - 20,000 for graduates (less than minimum wage) 💸😭 - **No contracts**: Fired anytime, no benefits 📄❌ - **No job security**: "Probation" periods that last forever ⏳😰 - **Exploitation**: Expected to work 10+ hours, weekends, no overtime pay 😓⏰ **You're employed but still broke.** 💼💸😔 --- ## The Borrowing Cycle: Rob Peter to Pay Paul 🔄💰 When you can't make ends meet, you start borrowing: 💸 ### The Vicious Cycle 🔄😰 **Month 1:** 📅 - Borrow **Ksh 5,000** from Bob (friend) to pay rent 👨💰 **Month 2:** 📅 - Borrow **Ksh 7,000** from Paul (relative) to pay Bob back + buy food 👴💸🍽️ **Month 3:** 📅 - Borrow **Ksh 10,000** from John (mobile loan app) to pay Paul back + pay rent 📱💰 - **Interest**: 20% = you now owe John **Ksh 12,000** 📈😱 **Month 4:** 📅 - Borrow **Ksh 15,000** from Jane (chama/savings group) to pay John 👩💵 - Still need to eat, pay rent, transport... 🍽️🏠🚌 **Month 5:** 📅 - Borrow **Ksh 20,000** from digital lenders (Tala, Branch, M-Shwari) 📱💸 - **Interest**: 15-20% 📊 - **Now owe**: Ksh 24,000 💔 **Month 6:** 📅 - Can't pay anyone 😭❌ - CRB (Credit Reference Bureau) listing 📋🚫 - No more loans available 💸❌ - Relatives stop picking up your calls 📞🔇 - Friends avoid you 👥➡️👻 **You're trapped.** 🔒💔 ### The Mobile Loan Trap Digital lending apps in Kenya: - **Tala, Branch, M-Shwari, Fuliza, KCB M-PESA...** - **Easy to get**: Instant approval - **Deadly interest**: 15-20% per month (not per year!) - **CRB blacklisting**: Miss one payment, you're blocked from all formal credit - **Harassment**: Daily calls, SMS, threats **A Ksh 5,000 loan becomes Ksh 8,000 in 3 months if unpaid.** You borrow to survive. You can't repay. You borrow again. **The cycle never ends.** --- ## Inflation: The Silent Killer While you're struggling to survive, **prices keep going up**: ### Real Kenya Inflation (2020 → 2025)
| Item | 2020 Price | 2025 Price | Increase | |------|-----------|-----------|----------| | **2kg Maize Flour (Unga)** | Ksh 100 | Ksh 230 | +130% | | **1L Cooking Oil** | Ksh 200 | Ksh 450 | +125% | | **1L Milk** | Ksh 100 | Ksh 150 | +50% | | **1kg Sugar** | Ksh 100 | Ksh 180 | +80% | | **Transport (Nairobi, 10km)** | Ksh 50 | Ksh 100 | +100% | | **Rent (Bedsitter, Nairobi)** | Ksh 6,000 | Ksh 10,000 | +67% | | **Electricity (50 units)** | Ksh 500 | Ksh 900 | +80% |
**Your salary?** Maybe increased by 10% (if you're lucky). **Inflation is running faster than your income.** --- ## Taxation: Death by a Thousand Cuts As if low wages and high costs weren't enough, the government keeps **inventing new taxes**: ### Taxes in Kenya (Growing List) 1. **Income Tax (PAYE)**: 10-30% of your salary 2. **VAT**: 16% on almost everything 3. **Housing Levy**: 1.5% of gross salary (mandatory) 4. **NHIF**: Ksh 500 - 1,700/month (healthcare) 5. **NSSF**: 6% of salary (pension) 6. **Fuel Levy**: Increases transport and food costs 7. **Digital Services Tax**: 1.5% on online services 8. **Import Duty**: Makes everything expensive 9. **Excise Duty**: On alcohol, cigarettes, even bottled water 10. **County Taxes**: Business permits, cess, parking... **You earn Ksh 30,000.** **After taxes:** ~Ksh 21,000 **After rent, transport, food:** ~Ksh 2,000 left **And they're planning more taxes:** - Motor vehicle tax - Eco-levy on plastics - Social health insurance (replacing NHIF) **Every new tax announcement = less money in your pocket.** --- ## Even Professionals Are Suffering ### Doctors, Teachers, Engineers—All Struggling **Kenyan doctors** (2024 strike): - Internship stipend: **Ksh 70,000/month** - After 7 years of medical school - After Ksh 500,000+ in loans - **Government owes them 6+ months of unpaid salaries** - They went on **strike for 56 days** - Some work in hospitals with **no water, no equipment, no drugs** **Teachers** (perpetual strikes): - Average salary: **Ksh 25,000 - 40,000/month** - Expected to teach 40+ students per class - Buy their own teaching materials - Walk 5km+ to rural schools - **Unpaid allowances for years** **Engineers**: - Degree cost: Ksh 600,000+ (4-5 years) - Graduate to find: **No jobs** - Or: Paid Ksh 20,000/month as "interns" - Work for years with no contracts, no benefits **Even the "successful" professionals are protesting unpaid and underpaid services.** If doctors and teachers can't survive, **what hope do the rest of us have?** --- ## The Capitalist Scavenger System ### How Capitalism Feeds on You Until You Die **Stage 1: Education (Ages 18-25)** - Take HELB loans - Take bank loans - Family fundraising (harambees) - **Debt: Ksh 400,000+** **Stage 2: Job Hunting (Ages 22-30)** - Spend money on: - CV printing, applications - Transport to interviews - Phone credit for follow-ups - "Smart" clothes for interviews - Borrow for rent while jobless - **Debt accumulates to Ksh 600,000+** **Stage 3: Low-Wage Employment (Ages 25-35)** - Finally get a job: Ksh 25,000/month - Pay HELB: Ksh 9,000 - Pay rent: Ksh 10,000 - Pay mobile loans: Ksh 5,000 - **You're left with Ksh 1,000 for food, transport, life** - Borrow more to survive **Stage 4: Marriage & Family (Ages 28-40)** - Get married (borrow for wedding) - Have kids (borrow for hospital bills) - School fees start (borrow for fees) - **Debt: Ksh 1,500,000+** **Stage 5: Middle Age (Ages 40-55)** - Still paying HELB (penalties, interest) - Still renting (can't afford land/house) - Kids in university (more HELB loans for them) - Health issues (borrow for treatment) - **Debt: Ksh 3,000,000+** **Stage 6: Old Age (Ages 55-70)** - Retire with nothing - NSSF pension: Ksh 5,000/month (if lucky) - Still in debt - Rely on children (who are also in debt) **Stage 7: Death** - Die in debt - Family inherits debt - Funeral fundraising (harambee) **Capitalism scavenges your entire life—from birth to death.** --- ## For Disabled People: The Rat Race on Hard Mode Now imagine running this rat race with **two legs broken** (literally). ### The Disabled Reality **Education Challenges:** - Most schools are **not accessible** (no ramps, no disabled toilets) - Teachers have **no training** for disabled students - Bullying, stigma, isolation - Higher **dropout rates** **HELB Loans:** - Disabled students get **the same loan amounts** (no special consideration) - But need **additional costs**: wheelchairs, assistive devices, medical care - **No loans for wheelchairs** (Ksh 50,000 - 200,000) - **No loans for prosthetics** (Ksh 100,000 - 500,000) **Employment Crisis (Worse for Disabled):** - **80%+ of disabled graduates** are unemployed - Employers cite "health risks," "insurance costs," "accessibility issues" - Even qualified disabled people are **rejected for their disability** - **No workplace accommodations** **The Borrowing Cycle:** - Disabled people need to borrow **MORE** (for medical care, assistive devices) - But get **LESS** (lenders see them as "high risk") - **No one gives loans for wheelchairs or prosthetics** **Inflation Hits Harder:** - Assistive devices? Imported = high cost + inflation - Medicine? Monthly expense - Accessible housing? More expensive **Taxation:** - Same taxes as everyone else - But **lower or no income** - **No tax breaks for disability expenses** **Even professionals who are disabled face:** - Discrimination - Inaccessible workplaces - Lower pay (if hired at all) **For disabled people, the rat race is not just hard—it's almost impossible to enter.** --- ## Why Mary & Lydia Can't Even Enter the Race 💔♿ Mary and Lydia face a **double whammy**: 😢💥 ### Mary's Reality 👩‍🦽 - **Living with disability** ♿ - Needs assistive devices: **Cost: Ksh 150,000+** 💰 - Can't access formal employment 💼❌ - No loans available (no collateral, seen as "high risk") 🏦🚫 - **Can't study** (no accessible schools nearby) 📚❌ - **Can't work** (no accessible workplaces) 💼🚫 - **Can't borrow** (no credit history, no income) 💸❌ ### Lydia's Reality 👧♿ - **Born with disabilities** 🎗️ - Needs prosthetics, wheelchairs, medical care: **Cost: Ksh 200,000+** 💰💊 - Same barriers as Mary 🚧 - Dependent on family (who are also broke) 👨‍👩‍👧💸 ### The Family Reality 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💔 - **Two disabled people in one household** ♿♿ - Medical costs: **Ksh 20,000+/month** 💊💰 - No income 💵❌ - No HELB loans (never went to university) 📚🚫 - No employment (can't access jobs) 💼❌ - No mobile loans (no income to repay) 📱💸❌ - **Complete exclusion from the rat race** 🐀🚫 **They're not even allowed to run—they're locked outside the cage.** 🔒💔 --- ## Breaking the Cycle: What Needs to Change 🔨🔓 ### Government & Policy Changes 🏛️📜 1. **Debt Forgiveness for Graduates** 🎓❌💸 - Cancel HELB loans after 10 years of non-repayment ✂️ - Base repayment on **income**, not fixed amounts 💰 2. **Universal Basic Income for Disabled People** ♿💵 - Monthly stipend to cover basic needs 🏠🍽️ - No conditions, no bureaucracy ✅ 3. **Tax Reform** 💸📊 - Stop inventing new taxes ✋❌ - Tax the ultra-wealthy, not the poor 💰⚖️ - Zero tax on basic food items 🍞🚫 4. **Employment Quotas** 💼✅ - Mandate 5% of jobs for disabled people ♿💼 - Penalties for non-compliance ⚠️ 5. **Accessible Education** 📚♿ - Free assistive devices for disabled students 🦽💊 - Accessible schools, trained teachers 🏫👨‍🏫 ### Individual & Community Actions 🤝💪 1. **Support Grassroots Charities** (like AbleHearts) 💝 - Direct support to disabled individuals 👥💰 - No middlemen, no bureaucracy ✅ 2. **Hire Disabled People** 💼♿ - If you own a business, give them a chance 🏢💪 - Remote work is accessible 💻🏠 3. **Advocate for Policy Change** 📢✊ - Sign petitions 📝 - Contact MPs 📞🏛️ - Vote for disability-friendly candidates 🗳️✅ 4. **Donate Directly** 💵➡️👥 - Skip big NGOs 🏢❌ - Support individuals like Mary & Lydia 💝♿ --- ## The Bottom Line 📝💔 **The rat race is brutal for everyone.** 🐀💨 - You borrow to study. 📚💸 - You graduate to no jobs. 🎓❌ - You borrow to survive. 🍽️💰 - You borrow from Bob to pay Paul. 👨➡️👴 - You borrow from John to pay Bob. 📱➡️👨 - Interest piles up. 📈💸 - Inflation eats your income. 📊😭 - Taxes drain what's left. 💰➡️🏛️ - Professionals protest unpaid wages. 👨‍⚕️✊ - You die in debt. ⚰️💸 **For disabled people, it's TWICE as hard:** ♿💔 - No access to education 📚❌ - No access to employment 💼🚫 - No access to loans 💸❌ - No access to the system 🔒 **Mary & Lydia aren't asking for much—just a chance to live with dignity.** 🙏💝 Your donation 💵 gives them that chance. ✨ --- ## Support Mary & Lydia 💝♿ **Help them escape the rat race 🐀 they were never allowed to enter.** [Donate Now](/donate) 👉💰 --- **#RatRace #Capitalism #StudentLoans #HELBKenya #Unemployment #Inflation #Disability #Poverty #EconomicJustice #AbleHearts** --- *The rat race is designed to keep you running. For disabled people, it's designed to keep them out entirely. Let's change that.* 💪✨
